overall: Strong final draft: checker ok_rate 1.0, all 134 pool tokens covered, facts check out, and no item needs firearms knowledge (gun-brand and gun-word tokens such as Colt, Browning, Remington, Glock, barrel, cartridge, recoil are tested only through non-gun senses). Exclusive calls (firearm(s), handgun, holster, musket, ordnance, revolver, shotguns, rapnel, tillery, the CJK gun character) are reasonable. The only clear violations are 8 items where the token sits in a removable padding clause and the question is fully answerable without it (looters/theft, saloon/Prohibition, gunpowder/Bonfire Night, muzzle/Hannibal Lecter, Waffen-SS/Himmler, cartridge/Game Boy, bulb/tulip mania, Remington/QWERTY); these are dropped. Several multi tokens are thin (1-3 items: breech, calib, caliber, pistol(s), rifle variants, Rif, reload, Webster, ject, bore, Colt), which the notes justify. A few items are mildly harder for a 2B model (woodbine, forbore, Sholokhov, Severn bore) but stay within general knowledge and are kept.
